18037-the-story-of-ida-pfeiffer-and-her-.title: The Story Of Ida Pfeiffer And Her Travels In Many Lands
18037-the-story-of-ida-pfeiffer-and-her-.creator: Unknown
18037-the-story-of-ida-pfeiffer-and-her-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. which the brave and spirited Ida felt most keenly. Some of the victorious troops were quartered in the house of her mother, who thought it politic to treat them with courtesy; but her daughter neither could nor would repress her dislike. When compelled to be present at a grand review which Napoleon held in Schonbrunn, she turned her back as the emperor rode past.

arxiv-2101-07017.title: Deep Universal Blind Image Denoising
arxiv-2101-07017.creator: Jae Woong Soh, Nam Ik Cho
arxiv-2101-07017.description: Abstract Image denoising is an essential part of many image processing and computer vision tasks due to inevitable noise corruption during image acquisition. Traditionally, many researchers have investigated image priors for the denoising, within the Bayesian perspective based on image properties and statistics.

arxiv-2105-04867.title: Experimental quantum memristor
arxiv-2105-04867.creator: Michele Spagnolo, Joshua Morris, Simone Piacentini, Michael Antesberger, Francesco Massa, Andrea Crespi, Francesco Ceccarelli, Roberto Osellame, Philip Walther
arxiv-2105-04867.description: Abstract Quantum computer technology harnesses the features of quantum physics for revolutionizing information processing and computing Gyongyosi and Imre 2019 . As such, quantum computers use physical quantum gates that process information unitarily, even though the final computing steps might be measurement-based or non-unitary Raussendorf and Briegel 2001 ; Walther et al. 2005 .

arxiv-2106-02008.title: Dependence of phase behavior and surface tension on particle stiffness for active Brownian particles †
arxiv-2106-02008.creator: Nicholas Lauersdorf, Thomas Kolb, Moslem Moradi, Ehssan Nazockdast, Daphne Klotsa
arxiv-2106-02008.description: Abstract We study quasi two-dimensional, monodisperse systems of active Brownian particles (ABPs) for a range of activities, stiffnesses, and densities. We develop a microscopic, analytical method for predicting the dense phase structure formed after motility-induced phase separation (MIPS) has occurred, including the dense cluster’s area fraction, interparticle pressure, and radius.

arxiv-2110-11113.title: Quantum Chaos and Universal Trotterisation Behaviours in Digital Quantum Simulations
arxiv-2110-11113.creator: Cahit Kargi, Juan Pablo Dehollain, Lukas M. Sieberer, Fabio Henriques, Tobias Olsacher, Philipp Hauke, Markus Heyl, Peter Zoller, Nathan K. Langford
arxiv-2110-11113.description: Abstract Digital quantum simulation (DQS) is one of the most promising paths for achieving first useful real-world applications for industry-scale quantum processors. Yet even assuming continued rapid progress in device engineering and successful development of fault-tolerant quantum processors, extensive algorithmic resource optimisation will long remain crucial to exploit their full computational power.

arxiv-2111-10274.title: Un autre calcul des fonctions inversibles sur l’espace symétrique de Drinfeld
arxiv-2111-10274.creator: Damien Junger
arxiv-2111-10274.description: Abstract Résumé In this article, we give an explicit description of the invertible functions on the Drinfeld symmetric space over K K a finite extension of ℚ p \mathbb{Q}_{p} . We identify them with some distribution spaces over the profinite set of K K -rationnal points of the projective space.

arxiv-2211-09266.title: General model for charge carriers transport in electrolyte-gated transistors
arxiv-2211-09266.creator: Marcos Luginieski, Marlus Koehler, José P. M. Serbena, Keli F. Seidel
arxiv-2211-09266.description: Abstract Inspired by experimental observations related to electrolyte-gated transistors (EGTs) where non-ideals behaviors are shown and not described by just one theoretical model, we proposed a charge carriers transport model able to describe the typical modes of operation profiles as well as some non-ideals ones from electrolyte-gated field effect transistors (EGOFETs) and organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs).

arxiv-2211-16213.title: Identification of Rare Cortical Folding Patterns using Unsupervised Deep Learning
arxiv-2211-16213.creator: Louise Guillon, Joël Chavas, Audrey Bénézit, Marie-Laure Moutard, Denis Rivière, Jean-François Mangin
arxiv-2211-16213.description: Abstract Like fingerprints, cortical folding patterns are unique to each brain even though they follow a general species-specific organization. Some folding patterns have been linked with neurodevelopmental disorders. However, due to the high inter-individual variability, the identification of rare folding patterns that could become biomarkers remains a very complex task.

arxiv-2407-02673.title: A Novel Approach to Image EEG Sleep Data for Improving Quality of Life in Patients Suffering From Brain Injuries Using DreamDiffusion
arxiv-2407-02673.creator: David Fahim, Joshveer Grewal, Ritvik Ellendula
arxiv-2407-02673.description: Abstract Those experiencing strokes, traumatic brain injuries, and drug complications can often end up hospitalized and diagnosed with coma or locked-in syndrome. Such mental impediments can permanently alter the neurological pathways in work and significantly decrease the quality of life (QoL).

arxiv-2411-01897.title: LE-PDE++: Mamba for accelerating PDEs Simulations
arxiv-2411-01897.creator: Aoming Liang, Zhaoyang Mu, Qi Liu, Ruipeng Li, Mingming Ge, Dixia Fan
arxiv-2411-01897.description: Abstract Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) are foundational in modeling science and natural systems such as fluid dynamics and weather forecasting. The Latent Evolution of PDEs (LE-PDE) method is designed to address the computational intensity of classical and deep learning-based PDE solvers by proposing a scalable and efficient alternative.

arxiv-2411-03705.title: RHIC s N ​ N = 200 \sqrt{s_{NN}}=200 GeV hadron yields and the isospin dependent equation of state
arxiv-2411-03705.creator: Feyisola Nana, Jordi Salinas San Martín, Jacquelyn Noronha-Hostler
arxiv-2411-03705.description: Abstract The statistical hadronization model has been successful in extracting information at chemical freeze-out in heavy-ion collisions. At RHIC, with a collision energy of s N ​ N = 200 \sqrt{s_{NN}}=200 GeV, many different ion species have been used for A A + A A collisions.

britannica-1911-arnaldus-de-villa-nova.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-arnaldus-de-villa-nova.description: Article 'Arnaldus de Villa Nova' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Hauréau in the Histoire littéraire de la France (1881), vol. Lalande, Arnaud de Villeneuve, sa vie et ses œuvres (Paris, 1896). A list of writings is given by J. gao-gaoreports-gao-08-717t.description: Higher Education: Multiple Higher Education Tax Incentives Create Opportunities for Taxpayers to Make Costly Mistakes (2008).

plaw-109-354-2006.creator: United States Congress
plaw-109-354-2006.description: Public Law 109-354 (2006): An act to revise the boundaries of John H. Chafee Coastal Barrier Resources System Jekyll Island Unit GA-06P.

pmc-10561670.title: Development of two highly sensitive and selective sensor-assisted fluorescence immunoassays for trace determination of copper residues in food samples
pmc-10561670.creator: Ibrahim A. Darwish, Zongzhi Wang, Ryhan J. Darling, Nourah Z. Alzoman
pmc-10561670.description: This study describes the development of two highly sensitive and selective sensor-assisted fluorescence immunoassays for the trace determination of copper ions, Cu(ii) residues, in food samples. These assays were the microwell-based fluoroimmuoassay (FIA) and the kinetic exclusion assay (KinExA). FIA and KinExA were assisted by a microplate reader and a KinExA™ 3200 immunosensor, respectively.

pmc-10744541.title: Comparative Diversity and Functional Traits of Fungal Endophytes in Response to Elevated Mineral Content in a Mangrove Ecosystem
pmc-10744541.creator: James Kennard S. Jacob, Katja Witzel, Thomas Edison E. dela Cruz
pmc-10744541.description: This study investigates the impact of water quality, specifically elevated phosphate and zinc content, on the diversity and functional properties of mangrove fungal endophytes in two distinct mangrove forests. Mangrove plant performance is directly related to the presence of fungal leaf endophytes as these fungi could enhance plant health, resilience, and adaptability under stressed environmental conditions.

pmc-11470630.title: Compensation for metabolic dietitians practicing in the United States: 2023 genetic metabolic dietitians international professional status survey
pmc-11470630.creator: Krista Viau, Sommer Gaughan, Jessica Kopesky, Beth Ogata, Heather Saavedra, Mary Sowa, Erin MacLeod
pmc-11470630.description: BackgroundGenetic Metabolic Dietitians International (GMDI) conducted a professional status survey of metabolic dietitians working in the United States to describe job satisfaction and establish salary and compensation benchmarks specific to metabolic dietitians.MethodsThe survey was anonymously administered in a web-based format via REDCap between October and November 2023. Registered dietitians working with inborn errors of metabolism (IEM) were eligible to participate.

pmc-12365289.title: Dose-response relationship between accelerometer-measured physical activity and depression: evidence from the UK Biobank
pmc-12365289.creator: Shuangfa Qiu, Zhenhua Xing
pmc-12365289.description: Studies on the relationship between physical activity (PA) and depression often rely on self-reported data, with a predominant focus on moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA). However, research examining accelerometer-measured PA, particularly light physical activity (LPA), and its impact on depression risk in the general population remains limited.

pmc-12437513.title: Evaluation of Depression, Anxiety, Stress, and Burnout Levels Among Emergency and Intensive Care Unit Professionals
pmc-12437513.creator: S. Kukurt, G. Dokuz, O. Kilic, Z. L. Onat, M. Combas, I. Kirpinar
pmc-12437513.description: IntroductionEmergency departments (ED) and intensive care units (ICU) are high-stress environments where healthcare professionals are continuously exposed to critical situations. This results in substantial mental health burdens, leading to increased levels of depression, anxiety, stress, and burnout. These issues negatively affect both the well-being of professionals and patient care.

pmc-12515741.title: Osseous Sarcoidosis of the Clivus Causing Cranial Nerve VI Palsy: A Case Report
pmc-12515741.creator: Xin P Wei, Taylor N LaFlam, Elham Khanafshar, Susan Kim, William D Soulsby
pmc-12515741.description: Sarcoidosis is an inflammatory condition characterized by the presence of noncaseating, or nonnecrotizing, granulomas in one or more organ systems. It has a wide range of clinical presentations and often mimics other conditions, making it difficult to diagnose. Osseous sarcoidosis of the skull base is extremely rare and has not previously been reported in a young adult patient.

pmc-12552858.title: Coronary artery anomalies: A case of the “malignant” left coronary artery and its surgical management
pmc-12552858.creator: Waliya Badar Hossain, Kumail Abbas Khan, Sophia Khattak, Farhan Shahid, Sohail Q. Khan
pmc-12552858.description: BackgroundAny variance of the normal coronary vasculature is regarded as a coronary artery anomaly (CAA). An atypical left coronary artery arising from the right aortic sinus of Valsalva has been identified as the rarest CAA and the second leading cause of sudden cardiac death (SCD) in young people.

pmc-12660762.title: Flexible time-restricted eating combined with exercise in a free-living setting for middle-aged women with overweight/obesity: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12660762.creator: Zihan Dai, Masashi Miyashita, Eric Tsz-chun Poon, Xiao Yu Tian, Angus Pak-hung Yu, Cindy Hui-ping Sit, Stephen Heung-sang Wong
pmc-12660762.description: Obesity poses a significant public health challenge among middle-aged women, driven by physiological changes associated with aging and menopause. This parallel-group, assessor-blinded, four-arm randomized controlled trial investigated the effects of 12-week 8-hour flexible time-restricted eating (flexTRE) and aerobic exercise (EX), alone or in combination (flexTRE+EX), on body composition and metabolic health in a free-living setting.

pmc-12971563.title: Comprehensive analysis identifies PKMYT1 as an oncogene and potential prognostic and immunological biomarker in lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-12971563.creator: Yuanze Cai, Kexin Luo, Meihan Liu, Haiyang Zhao, Guoyi Li, Yumeng Lei, Daiyuan Ma, Yongsheng Zhao, Hongpan Zhang
pmc-12971563.description: BackgroundLung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, underscoring the urgent need for novel prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Although PKMYT1, a serine/threonine protein kinase, is implicated in cell cycle regulation, its comprehensive role and clinical significance in LUAD remain poorly defined.

pmc-13052188.title: The Diagnostic Promise of Serum S100B Protein in Pregnancy‐Related Hypertension: A Narrative Review
pmc-13052188.creator: Moldir Dossimbetova, Nurgul Ablakimova, Lazzat Balymbetova, Andrei Gaiday, Kazbek Yermagambetov, Saule Bermagambetova, Mukhit Sarsembayev, Gulnara Gubasheva, Andrii Dinets, Akylbek Tussupkaliyev
pmc-13052188.description: BackgroundHypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) are a major cause of illness and death for mothers and babies worldwide. Their number is rising due to older maternal age, obesity, and other health problems. Early diagnosis is important. Serum protein S100B, a calcium‐binding protein studied in brain diseases, is now being considered as a possible marker for predicting HDP.

pmc-13088716.title: Correction: Peptide‑based therapeutics targeting the SLC39A14‑PIWIL2 fusion in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13088716.creator: Masaud Shah, Sung Ung Moon, Ji‑Hye Choi, Min Jae Kim, Hyun Goo Woo
pmc-13088716.description: ting interests. The correct competing interests section reads: Competing interests Author Hyun Goo Woo is Editor-in-Chief of Genomics & Informatics. The paper was handled by another Editor and underwent a rigorous peer review process. Author Hyun Goo Woo was not involved in the journal's peer review of, or decisions related to, this manuscript.

pmc-13315728.title: OCPP integrated artificial intelligence for forecasting scheduling and anomaly detection in city scale electric vehicle charging under urban tariffs
pmc-13315728.creator: Md Sabbir Hossen, Gobbi Ramasamy, Ngu Eng Eng, Siow Jat Shern, Md Tanjil Sarker
pmc-13315728.description: Urban EV uptake is raising feeder peaks and energy costs in city networks. We present an AI framework integrated with the open charge point protocol (OCPP), a standard communication protocol for EV charging systems that combines short-horizon demand forecasting with tariff-aware and fairness-aware scheduling and runtime anomaly detection from charger telemetry. Decisions are encoded with OCPP 1.6 and 2.0.

pmc-13464505.title: Beyond defense: GTR-mediated uptake of glucosinolates drives growth and structural reprogramming in broccoli seedlings
pmc-13464505.creator: Lorena Albaladejo-Marico, Christa Kanstrup, Christoph Crocoll, Micaela Carvajal, Josip Tomas, Marie Schuler, Arnaud Tatibouet, Hussam Hassan Nour-Eldin, Lucia Yepes-Molina

pmc-13549370.title: Preoperative standing–supine difference in joint line convergence angle predicts postoperative alignment change after closing‐wedge high tibial osteotomy
pmc-13549370.creator: Mitsuhiko Kubo, Kazuhiro Uenaka, Hitomi Fujikawa, Tsutomu Maeda, Kosuke Kumagai, Yuki Nosaka, Sadafumi Horikawa, Shinji Imai
pmc-13549370.description: PurposeThe aim of this study was to identify preoperative determinants of postoperative change in joint line convergence angle (JLCA) after closing‐wedge high tibial osteotomy (CWHTO), comparing standing‐ and supine‐based radiographic references for preoperative planning.MethodsConsecutive patients with medial compartmental knee disorders who underwent CWHTO between February 2009 and September 2017 were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-13553157.title: The Effect of Personalised Feedback in Simulation on Knowledge and Skills in the Management of Bleeding During Pregnancy: A Parallel Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13553157.creator: Mine Gökduman Keleş, Sema Göçmez
pmc-13553157.description: BackgroundCombining simulation‐based training with structured feedback enhances skill acquisition and professional competence. Simulation‐based education is essential for preparing nurses and midwives to manage obstetric haemorrhage and other critical emergencies requiring rapid clinical decision‐making.AimThis study was conducted to determine the effect of personalised feedback in simulation on knowledge and skills related to the management of bleeding during pregnancy.

pmc-13603513.title: Examining Teacher Self-Efficacy and Work Engagement Among Chinese School-Level EFL Teachers: The Mediating Roles of Teaching Anxiety and Enjoyment
pmc-13603513.creator: Zixin Xie, Yumei Fan
pmc-13603513.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The affective turn in language education has prompted increasing scholarly attention to teachers’ emotional experiences. While teacher self-efficacy has been recognized as a predictor of work engagement, the mediating roles of specific teaching emotions remain underexplored. Grounded in the “EMPATHICS” framework, this study investigated how foreign language teaching anxiety (FLTA) and enjoyment (FLTE) mediate the relationship between self-efficacy and work engagement among school-level EFL teachers.

pmc-13613772.title: Testicular malakoplakia in a middle-aged Han Chinese male: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-13613772.creator: Zhongqin Ruan, Xiaojuan Ma, Yang Chen, Jiaojiao Zhou, Buyun Ma
pmc-13613772.description: BackgroundTesticular malakoplakia (MP) is an extremely rare chronic granulomatous inflammatory lesion. It lacks specific clinical or imaging features and is highly prone to misdiagnosis as a testicular tumor. To our knowledge, no reports have described the contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) manifestations of this condition.

uslaw-usc-t44-s1320.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t44-s1320.description: United States Code, Title 44 (Public Printing And Documents); Chapter 13 (Particular Reports And Documents). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Director of the Geological Survey shall distribute to public libraries that have not already received them, copies of sale publications on hand at the expiration of five years after date of delivery to the Survey document room, excepting a reserve number.
